column1: # Criteria fixed before the runs they grade, with the commits that are the
# record.  Read by check_criterion_timing_matches_the_history.
# This tree is a snapshot of its development repository and carries no history
# of its own, so every script arrives in one commit together with the results
# it grades.  The commit order that is the record is in the development
# repository for the last two rows, and for the rows before them in the tree
# that repository was ported from, qf_kor, at its commit 2bc0a4b.  Each row
# below was verified there with `git merge-base --is-ancestor`: the
# criterion's commit is an ancestor of the commit adding the results, not
# merely an earlier date.
# A commit hash in a mutable tree is not an identifier a reader can resolve.
# This file discharges this repository's own gate.  It is not evidence a reader can
# check, and no sentence in the manuscript rests on it.
# Adding a row here does not make a claim true.  A script that arrives at the
# port commit and is absent from this file fails the gate; a row naming a
# script that no longer claims its timing, or that was added after the port,
# fails it too.  A claiming script added after the port is graded by this
# repository's own history, as it would be in any tree.
